[[Coral Deep]] |sandbox = Yes |rewards_increase = None }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|In the depths of the ocean.|In-Game Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Scuba Gear''', internally referred to as just '''Scuba''', is a cosmetic [[Modifiers|modifier]] that adds scuba helmets onto every enemy and adds bubble particles when an enemy dies. '''Scuba Gear''' appears exclusively in [[Abyssal Trench]] and [[Coral Deep]]; it is active in all matches on these maps. ==Effects== When active, '''Scuba Gear''' modifier will add scuba helmets onto every enemy and bubble particles when an enemy dies. If an enemy has a death animation, the bubble death effect will play after the enemy disappears entirely. It will be overridden by the [[Cowboy (Modifier)|Cowboy]] modifier when it is active on all maps, though the bubble death effect will still play. On some enemies like the [[Normal]], the scuba helmet may be much bigger than it should be. ===Enemy Appearance=== ''This does not include every enemy in the game, but only some to show the effects of the modifier.'' NormalScubaGearMod.png|[[Normal]] affected by the '''Scuba Gear''' modifier. AbnormalScubaGearMod.png|[[Abnormal]] affected by the '''Scuba Gear''' modifier. MoltenNecromancerScubaGearMod.png|[[Molten Necromancer]] affected by the '''Scuba Gear''' modifier. SockPuppetScubaGearMod.png|[[Sock Puppet]] affected by the '''Scuba Gear''' modifier. MoltenTitanScubaGearMod.png|[[Molten Titan]] affected by the '''Scuba Gear''' modifier. MoltenWarlordScubaGearMod.png|[[Molten Warlord]] affected by the '''Scuba Gear''' modifier. ==Trivia== *The scuba helmet added onto every enemy is the {{RLinkC|12436407|Bathysphere}} accessory from the Roblox catalog. ==Update History== *'''4 July 2022''' - [[v1.2.5]] **'''Scuba Gear''' added. *'''9 July 2025''' - [[v1.70.0]] **'''Scuba Gear''' is now active in [[Coral Deep]]. {{ModifierNavBox}}
